import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream

cases = {
    "LF": "X=1\nY=2\nZ=3\n",
    "CRLF": "X=1\r\nY=2\r\nZ=3\r\n",
    "MIXED (test_lines)": "X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n",
    "blank lines LF": "X=1\n\nY=2\n",
    "blank lines CRLF": "X=1\r\n\r\nY=2\r\n",
}
for name, text in cases.items():
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))
    print(f"--- {name} ---")
    for r in rows:
        print(f"  key={r.key!r:6} value={r.value!r:6} line={r.original.line} string={r.original.string!r}")
    print("  lines:", [r.original.line for r in rows])
EOF
